gates.weight_dma_reduction: W00 or W02 must reduce static weight bytes by at least 20 percent
gates.dependency: each mode-4 TIR has balanced push/pop pairs and no direct 1<->3 pair
gates.correctness: each representative exactly matches an independent NumPy reference for all three seeds
gates.pure_tir: barrier closes pre/post segments; no-barrier behavior remains unchanged
gates.regression: frozen original TIR and modes 0-3 pass

stop_rule: freeze a negative result if C++ semantics are unsafe, build fails, DMA gate fails, dependency audit fails, or FSim fails
performance_rule: FSim time is never a performance result
